title: Hexus Salts Watermelon Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Watermelon Ice by Hexus pairs the clean, delicate sweetness of fresh Watermelon with a bright, cooling Ice layer. The Watermelon flavour is soft and juicy, offering an easy-going fruit base that’s lifted by a crisp streak of Menthol. It’s a smooth, refreshing vape with a light texture that makes it ideal for all-day use. This e-liquid uses nicotine salts to deliver fast-absorbing nicotine and a smooth, comfortable throat hit. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s made for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in pod kits, vape pens and low-powered starter devices. Part of the Hexus Nic Salt range, Watermelon Ice is available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, with a full line-up of fruity and cool blends for flavour-focused MTL vapers.
